question: Where should our six-person group go hiking November 14–21, 2026? Consider Banff, Patagonia, the Dolomites or another feasible option. No destination has been selected.

participants.name: Sarah
participants.goal: Find a trip everyone can attend
hard_constraints: Total cost at most $2,000 per person
participants.private_information: Your budget is firm, not a negotiating tactic. You are open to shortening the trip.

participants.name: Alex
participants.goal: Get several days of challenging hiking
participants.private_information: You can accept a less novel destination if the hiking is good.

participants.name: Maya
hard_constraints: No individual flight leg longer than six hours
participants.private_information: You are departing San Francisco. The flight limit is firm; do not infer or disclose a medical reason.

participants.name: Ben
participants.goal: Avoid arriving to find hiking services closed
participants.private_information: You heard many Dolomites huts close in November, but have not checked specific operators or dates. Present it as an unverified claim.

participants.name: Priya
participants.goal: Have a memorable trip with friends
participants.private_information: Novelty is a preference, not a requirement. You will compromise to keep everyone included.

participants.name: Leo
preferences: Otherwise a destination Maya can reach
participants.private_information: You have not made an unconditional commitment to Patagonia.
